claims.claim: Seller identifies Zen12 and Hypnosis Live in portfolio
One hour meditation benefits in twelve minutes
Beginner is first six levels, 24 MP3s
Premium is all 12 levels, 48 MP3s
Advanced is final six levels, 24 MP3s
Public seller showed Beginner 67.77 USD, Premium 87.99 USD, Advanced 67.77 USD on Nov 13 2026; live checkout, taxes and conditions not audited
Seller advertises one-year refund promise; not independently verified in transaction
Gift page states recipients will receive Zen12 newsletter
Total Focus is 33-minute/47MB download written and recorded by J.A. Amos
Product will give limitless powers of concentration
Focus Shot includes 15- and 30-minute versions and bonus brainwave-only versions
Four hours or more of guaranteed focus
Color word/ink naming conflict demonstrated in original Stroop research
Suggestion altered Stroop interference for selected highly suggestible subjects
Suggestion decreased Stroop interference with and without induction in that protocol
In flanker experiments only highly susceptible induction group showed eliminated flanker effect; experiment 2 suggestion alone did not
Neuroimaging examined conflict changes with suggestion
2023 systematic review included fourteen heterogeneous binaural-beat EEG studies with conflicting outcomes
Puységur archive labels testimony/ethics/witness claims separately from mechanism
Existing Focus Fieldbook offers 52-page guide via existing subscription path
Disclose unexpected material connections clearly next to recommendations
Health-related product benefit claims need appropriate evidence, not just testimonials
Generic portal advertises an affiliate program; does not establish Final Vestige publisher acceptance or actual links
Published change blindness research accessible for relevant source-led social traffic
Published Franklin commission report analysis accessible
